code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O2 saturation, low pO2), mild anemia with microcytosis, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia, monocytosis, and elevated ferritin. Mildly increased RDW and abnormal white cell differential suggest possible underlying inflammation or infection. Liver and kidney function are preserved. Findings are consistent with acute respiratory failure and possible underlying infection or inflammatory process; urgent clinical assessment is recommended.
